cases.narrative:
ctr rises 72.7% on os_version=Android 14 AND vertical=travel (localized; confidence 0.30).

## What moved
- os_version=Android 14 AND vertical=travel moved 72.7% relative to expectation, with an expected level of 0.0103887 and an observed level of 0.0179384, flagged by the structural detector.

## Why this segment
- sufficiency test failed because the test condition was not met.
- minimality test failed because the test condition was not met.
- maximality test passed because the test condition was met.
- holdout test passed because the test condition was met.

## What was ruled out
- os_version=Android 13 was cleared because it predicted 0.00916947 if the accused explains everything and observed 0.0107641, with residual +0.00159468 within tolerance, so this segment's movement is fully accounted for.

## What could not be tested
- 40 candidates were considered and 0 candidates cleared, leaving breadth-tested segments that explained less of the movement than the accused segment without being fully cleared candidates.

## Confidence
- Confidence score 0.30, derived from 0 candidates cleared out of 40 candidates considered.

children.name: audit
children.what: Checked whether the baseline still describes this population
children.why: A baseline drawn from a population that has since changed produces confident, internally consistent, wrong answers, and nothing downstream can detect that. A calibrated baseline disagrees with a few percent of a recent window; one describing the wrong population disagrees with most of it.
children.result: Baseline calibrated: 1.3% of cells flagged on a recent window, under 10%.

children.why: An anomaly confined to one intersection barely moves either dimension on its own, and a pair moving in opposite directions leaves every total unchanged. Neither is visible to a scan that compares against the past.
children.result: 1 cell(s) beyond 5.0 standard errors, with the table scattering 1.0x wider than pure sampling error predicts.

children.name: correct
children.what: Benjamini-Hochberg at alpha=0.01 over 14,683 tests
children.why: At an uncorrected threshold, one cell in a hundred crosses it by chance, which across this lattice means dozens of confident findings in data where nothing happened.
children.result: 46 finding(s) survived

children.name: localize:ctr
children.what: Localizing the rise in ctr
children.why: The detector says a metric moved; it does not say where. Localization removes each candidate in turn and asks whether the parent returns to expectation.
children.result: accused os_version=Android 14 AND vertical=travel

children.name: localize:ctr
children.what: Tested 40 candidate segments by removing each one from the population and recomputing the parent metric.
children.why: Segments correlated with the cause move too, and often by a large and significant amount. Ranking cannot tell a cause from a passenger; a counterfactual can.
children.result: os_version=Android 14 AND vertical=travel accounts for 0% of a -9.89476e-06 movement and survived the breadth tests.

children.name: mechanism:ctr:os_version|vertical
children.what: Split the aggregate movement into three exactly additive parts: segments' own rates changing at fixed traffic shares, traffic shares changing at fixed rates, and the two moving together.
children.why: Removing a segment repairs the parent whether that segment broke or merely grew, so the counterfactual cannot tell a fault from a traffic shift. They call for different responses from different teams.
children.result: Rates and traffic mix moved together in ctr, so neither explains the movement on its own and the split between them is not identifiable. Rate +0.0000, mix +0.0000, interaction -0.0000, against a total movement of -0.0000.

children.name: confidence
children.what: Scoring the verdict across its graded components
children.why: A verdict with no confidence attached forces an operator to treat a marginal result and an overwhelming one identically.
children.result: 0.30 from 3/5 components

steps_flat.name: investigate

steps_flat.name: audit

steps_flat.why: A baseline drawn from a population that has since changed produces confident, internally consistent, wrong answers, and nothing downstream can detect that. A calibrated baseline disagrees with a few percent of a recent window; one describing the wrong population disagrees with most of it.

steps_flat.name: confidence

confidence_json.name: significance
confidence_json.detail: p = 0.00061 is 3.2 decades of evidence, 44% of the way from the floor at p = 0.1 to full credit at p = 1e-06. Re-tested after the localizer had already named this cell, so the p-value carries a selection effect no correction here accounts for, and this component is capped at 0.25. The localization gates, not this number, are the argument.

confidence_json.name: sufficiency
confidence_json.detail: The parent metric did not move, so there is no parent deviation for this segment to account for and the counterfactual was never run. Scoring that as a failure would penalise the candidate for the shape of the incident.

confidence_json.name: minimality

children.why: The detector says a metric moved; it does not say where. Localization removes each candidate in turn and asks whether the parent returns to expectation.

children.name: localize:clicks
children.what: Tested 41 candidate segments by removing each one from the population and recomputing the parent metric.
children.why: Segments correlated with the cause move too, and often by a large and significant amount. Ranking cannot tell a cause from a passenger; a counterfactual can.
children.result: campaign_type=CPC AND region=APAC accounts for 36% of a +98 movement and survived the breadth tests.

children.name: confidence
children.what: Scoring the verdict across its graded components
children.why: A verdict with no confidence attached forces an operator to treat a marginal result and an overwhelming one identically.
children.result: 0.29 from 3/5 components

cases.narrative:
Impressions rises 1436.0% on country=US AND device_model=Galaxy A54 (unlocalized; confidence 0.00).

## What moved
- country=US AND device_model=Galaxy A54 moved 1436.0% relative to expectation, with an observed level of 21494 against an expected level of 1399.35, flagged by the structural detector.

## Why this segment
- country=US AND region=NAM failed the breadth test because parent moved +10359, and with country=US AND region=NAM removed it moves +8435, so 19% of the change is accounted for by this segment.
- os_version=iOS 18.1 failed the breadth test because parent moved +10359, and with os_version=iOS 18.1 removed it moves +8556, so 17% of the change is accounted for by this segment.
- category=entertainment failed the breadth test because removing category=entertainment AND publisher_tier=tier_2 collapses the deviation to 24% of its original size, meaning this candidate is too broad and the child is the real answer.
- os_version=Android 12 failed the breadth test because removing os_version=Android 12 AND region=NAM collapses the deviation to 28% of its original size, meaning this candidate is too broad and the child is the real answer.
- region=EU failed the breadth test because removing campaign_type=CPM AND region=EU collapses the deviation to 30% of its original size, meaning this candidate is too broad and the child is the real answer.
- vertical=auto failed the breadth test because removing campaign_type=CPM AND vertical=auto collapses the deviation to 25% of its original size, meaning this candidate is too broad and the child is the real answer.
- vertical=entertainment failed the breadth test because removing campaign_type=CPM AND vertical=entertainment collapses the deviation to 16% of its original size, meaning this candidate is too broad and the child is the real answer.
- ad_format=banner failed the breadth test because 100% of the 4 sibling values of ad_format moved the same way by a comparable amount, making the movement wider than this candidate so that naming it would be arbitrarily narrow.

## Confidence
- 0
- 41 candidates were considered.
- 0 candidates cleared.

children.name: localize:impressions

children.why: The detector says a metric moved; it does not say where. Localization removes each candidate in turn and asks whether the parent returns to expectation.
children.result: no candidate accused (explain_away)

children.name: localize:impressions
children.what: Tested 41 candidate segments by removing each one from the population and recomputing the parent metric.
children.why: Segments correlated with the cause move too, and often by a large and significant amount. Ranking cannot tell a cause from a passenger; a counterfactual can.
children.result: No candidate passed every applicable test. Reporting no verdict is the correct outcome rather than naming the best of a bad set.

children.name: confidence
children.what: Scoring the verdict across its graded components
children.why: A verdict with no confidence attached forces an operator to treat a marginal result and an overwhelming one identically.
children.result: 0.00 from 0/5 components

cases.narrative:
Fills rises 1410.7% on country=US AND device_model=Galaxy A54 (unlocalized; confidence 0.00).

## What moved
- country=US AND device_model=Galaxy A54 observed 21888 against expected 1448.9, moving 1410.7% relative to expectation, as flagged by the structural detector.

## Why this segment
- Breadth test for country=US AND region=NAM failed because Parent moved +10448. With country=US AND region=NAM removed it moves +8567, so 18% of the change is accounted for by this segment.
- Breadth test for os_version=iOS 18.1 failed because Parent moved +10448. With os_version=iOS 18.1 removed it moves +8618, so 18% of the change is accounted for by this segment.
- Breadth test for category=entertainment failed because Removing category=entertainment AND publisher_tier=tier_2 collapses the deviation to 23% of its original size. This candidate is too broad; the child is the real answer.
- Breadth test for os_version=Android 12 failed because Removing os_version=Android 12 AND region=NAM collapses the deviation to 29% of its original size. This candidate is too broad; the child is the real answer.
- Breadth test for region=EU failed because Removing campaign_type=CPM AND region=EU collapses the deviation to 30% of its original size. This candidate is too broad; the child is the real answer.
- Breadth test for vertical=auto failed because Removing campaign_type=CPM AND vertical=auto collapses the deviation to 26% of its original size. This candidate is too broad; the child is the real answer.
- Breadth test for vertical=entertainment failed because Removing campaign_type=CPM AND vertical=entertainment collapses the deviation to 15% of its original size. This candidate is too broad; the child is the real answer.
- Breadth test for ad_format=banner failed because 100% of the 4 sibling values of ad_format moved the same way by a comparable amount. The movement is wider than this candidate, so naming it would be arbitrarily narrow.

## Confidence
- Confidence score 0.00, with 41 candidates considered and 0 candidates cleared.

children.name: correct

children.why: At an uncorrected threshold, one cell in a hundred crosses it by chance, which across this lattice means dozens of confident findings in data where nothing happened.
children.result: 46 finding(s) survived

children.name: localize:fills
children.what: Localizing the rise in fills
children.why: The detector says a metric moved; it does not say where. Localization removes each candidate in turn and asks whether the parent returns to expectation.
children.result: no candidate accused (explain_away)

children.name: localize:fills
children.what: Tested 41 candidate segments by removing each one from the population and recomputing the parent metric.
children.why: Segments correlated with the cause move too, and often by a large and significant amount. Ranking cannot tell a cause from a passenger; a counterfactual can.
children.result: No candidate passed every applicable test. Reporting no verdict is the correct outcome rather than naming the best of a bad set.

children.name: confidence
children.what: Scoring the verdict across its graded components
children.why: A verdict with no confidence attached forces an operator to treat a marginal result and an overwhelming one identically.
children.result: 0.00 from 0/5 components

children.why: A baseline drawn from a population that has since changed produces confident, internally consistent, wrong answers, and nothing downstream can detect that. children.name: localize:requests
children.what: Localizing the rise in requests
children.why: The detector says a metric moved; it does not say where. Localization removes each candidate in turn and asks whether the parent returns to expectation.
children.result: no candidate accused (explain_away)

children.name: localize:requests
children.what: Tested 41 candidate segments by removing each one from the population and recomputing the parent metric.
children.why: Segments correlated with the cause move too, and often by a large and significant amount. Ranking cannot tell a cause from a passenger; a counterfactual can.
children.result: No candidate passed every applicable test. Reporting no verdict is the correct outcome rather than naming the best of a bad set.

children.name: confidence
children.what: Scoring the verdict across its graded components
children.why: A verdict with no confidence attached forces an operator to treat a marginal result and an overwhelming one identically.

children.name: correct

children.name: localize:fills
children.what: Localizing the fall in fills
children.why: The detector says a metric moved; it does not say where. Localization removes each candidate in turn and asks whether the parent returns to expectation.
children.result: no candidate accused (explain_away)

children.name: localize:fills
children.what: Tested 41 candidate segments by removing each one from the population and recomputing the parent metric.
children.why: Segments correlated with the cause move too, and often by a large and significant amount. Ranking cannot tell a cause from a passenger; a counterfactual can.
children.result: No candidate passed every applicable test. Reporting no verdict is the correct outcome rather than naming the best of a bad set.

children.name: confidence
children.what: Scoring the verdict across its graded components
children.why: A verdict with no confidence attached forces an operator to treat a marginal result and an overwhelming one identically.
children.result: 0.00 from 0/5 components

impressions falls 77.6% on campaign_type=CPI AND vertical=entertainment (unlocalized; confidence 0.00).

- Breadth test for country=US AND region=NAM failed because parent moved +10359 and with country=US AND region=NAM removed it moves +8435, so 19% of the change is accounted for by this segment

- Breadth test for ad_format=banner failed because 100% of the 4 sibling values of ad_format moved the same way by a comparable amount, making the movement wider than this candidate so naming it would be arbitrarily narrow

children.name: localize:impressions
children.what: Localizing the fall in impressions
children.why: The detector says a metric moved; it does not say where. Localization removes each candidate in turn and asks whether the parent returns to expectation.
children.result: no candidate accused (explain_away)

children.name: localize:impressions
children.what: Tested 41 candidate segments by removing each one from the population and recomputing the parent metric.
children.why: Segments correlated with the cause move too, and often by a large and significant amount. Ranking cannot tell a cause from a passenger; a counterfactual can.
children.result: No candidate passed every applicable test. Reporting no verdict is the correct outcome rather than naming the best of a bad set.

children.name: confidence
children.what: Scoring the verdict across its graded components
children.why: A verdict with no confidence attached forces an operator to treat a marginal result and an overwhelming one identically.
children.result: 0.00 from 0/5 components

steps_flat.result: 46 finding(s) survived

steps_flat.name: localize:impressions
steps_flat.what: Localizing the fall in impressions
steps_flat.why: The detector says a metric moved; it does not say where. Localization removes each candidate in turn and asks whether the parent returns to expectation.
steps_flat.result: no candidate accused (explain_away)

steps_flat.name: localize:impressions
steps_flat.what: Tested 41 candidate segments by removing each one from the population and recomputing the parent metric.
steps_flat.why: Segments correlated with the cause move too, and often by a large and significant amount. Ranking cannot tell a cause from a passenger; a counterfactual can.
steps_flat.result: No candidate passed every applicable test. Reporting no verdict is the correct outcome rather than naming the best of a bad set.

steps_flat.name: correct
steps_flat.what: Benjamini-Hochberg at alpha=0.01 over 14,683 tests
steps_flat.why: At an uncorrected threshold, one cell in a hundred crosses it by chance, which across this lattice means dozens of confident findings in data where nothing happened.
steps_flat.result: 46 finding(s) survived

steps_flat.name: localize:clicks
steps_flat.what: Localizing the fall in clicks
steps_flat.why: The detector says a metric moved; it does not say where. Localization removes each candidate in turn and asks whether the parent returns to expectation.
steps_flat.result: no candidate accused (structural_only)

steps_flat.name: localize:clicks
steps_flat.what: Tested 41 candidate segments by removing each one from the population and recomputing the parent metric.
steps_flat.why: Segments correlated with the cause move too, and often by a large and significant amount. Ranking cannot tell a cause from a passenger; a counterfactual can.
steps_flat.result: No candidate passed every applicable test. Reporting no verdict is the correct outcome rather than naming the best of a bad set.

steps_flat.name: confidence
steps_flat.what: Scoring the verdict across its graded components
steps_flat.why: A verdict with no confidence attached forces an operator to treat a marginal result and an overwhelming one identically.
steps_flat.result: 0.00 from 0/5 components
